      intro bs Hlen
      cases bs <;> simp_all

      cases bs with
      | nil => simp_all
      | cons b bs =>
        simp at Hlen
        simp [ih bs Hlen]

calc
      updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs =
          updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks vs) ks' vs' := Hcomm
      _ = updatedStates σ' ks' vs' := by
        rw [UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
      _ = σ'' := (InitStatesUpdated Hinit).symm

updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs =
          updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks vs) ks' vs' := Hcomm
      _ = updatedStates σ' ks' vs' := by
        rw [UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
      _ = σ'' := (InitStatesUpdated Hinit).symm
